ADRIAN.note: Adrian Cross, 34: tired ex-investigator; low, controlled

NOAH.note: Noah Reyes, 29: warm, quick; intimate, tense

RUSK.note: Tomas Rusk, 41: guard officer; clipped, guarded

MARA.note: Dr Mara Sen, 46: clinic doctor; natural, understated

CH01_M01_DLG001.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M01_DLG001.text: Hands where I can see them. Name.

CH01_M05_DLG015.speaker: RECORDING
CH01_M05_DLG015.text: Calibration log. Channel seven. Tell N the harbor light still turns.

CH01_M01_DLG002.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG002.text: Noah Reyes. My property stays with me.

CH01_M01_DLG003.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M01_DLG003.text: Your name does. The rest goes in the tray.

CH01_M01_DLG004.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG004.text: That photograph is all I have of my sister.

CH01_M01_DLG005.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M01_DLG005.text: Then remember what she looks like.

CH01_M01_DLG008.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M01_DLG008.text: No. I know what disappears here.

CH01_M01_DLG010.speaker: GUARD
CH01_M01_DLG010.text: Contract security signed the delivery. Same seal as last week.

CH01_M01_DLG011.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG011.text: The triangle. Where did that come from?

CH01_M01_DLG014.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG014.text: I know a crate I should never have opened.

CH01_M01_DLG015.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M01_DLG015.text: Thirteen, Cross. Fourteen, Reyes. Welcome home.

CH01_M01_DLG016.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M01_DLG016.text: Keep your voice below the pipes.

CH01_M01_DLG017.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG017.text: You first. How do you know that name?

CH01_M01_DLG018.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M01_DLG018.text: Because somebody killed a man and left it in my file.

CH01_M01_DLG019.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M01_DLG019.text: A receipt. You said I needed one.

CH01_M01_DLG020.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M01_DLG020.text: Property number forty-two. Keep the photograph. Lose the receipt and the rest was never here.

CH01_M01_DLG021.speaker: GUARD
CH01_M01_DLG021.text: Step onto the painted mark. Both feet.

CH01_M01_DLG022.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M01_DLG022.text: The stamp, Reyes. Look at the stamp.

CH01_M02_DLG003.speaker: SILAS
CH01_M02_DLG003.text: That was the invitation to ask.

CH01_M02_DLG004.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG004.text: He is on laundry. You break his hands, you wash your own sheets.

CH01_M02_DLG006.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG006.text: I am saving you a chore.

CH01_M02_DLG007.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG007.text: Reyes. The ball. West fence. Easy.

CH01_M02_DLG009.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG009.text: I want him looking somewhere else.

CH01_M02_DLG010.speaker: GUARD
CH01_M02_DLG010.text: Away from the fence! All of you!

CH01_M02_DLG011.speaker: SILAS
CH01_M02_DLG011.text: This buys you a morning. Nothing else.

CH01_M02_DLG012.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M02_DLG012.text: You always make friends this quickly?

CH01_M02_DLG013.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG013.text: Only when I need somebody alive.

CH01_M02_DLG014.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M02_DLG014.text: My sister Elena was on that run. They told me the boat burned.

CH01_M02_DLG016.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M02_DLG016.text: I saw a bag. They would not let me open it.

CH01_M02_DLG017.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG017.text: The man I was accused of killing was investigating VANTAGE transfers.

CH01_M02_DLG018.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M02_DLG018.text: So we have a logo and two dead people.

CH01_M02_DLG019.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG019.text: We have people who want us to stop asking.

CH01_M02_DLG022.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG022.text: Easy. We try when he turns again.

CH01_M02_DLG023.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M02_DLG023.text: I do not trust you yet.

CH01_M02_DLG024.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M02_DLG024.text: Then trust what we can both see.

CH01_M03_DLG001.speaker: MARA
CH01_M03_DLG001.text: Medical linen on the blue table. Keep it clear of the general wash.

CH01_M03_DLG002.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M03_DLG002.text: You are the doctor. Why are you counting sheets?

CH01_M03_DLG003.speaker: MARA
CH01_M03_DLG003.text: Because blood does not stop being evidence when somebody washes it.

CH01_M03_DLG005.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG005.text: This press is catching. We need the inspection lamp.

CH01_M03_DLG006.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M03_DLG006.text: You have one cycle. Then it works.

CH01_M03_DLG007.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG007.text: Lever down. Tell me when your hands are clear.

CH01_M03_DLG009.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M03_DLG009.text: There is a plan behind the screen.

CH01_M03_DLG010.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG010.text: Service corridor E. It runs behind our landing.

CH01_M03_DLG011.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M03_DLG011.text: Two relays. One opens the grille, one feeds the lock.

CH01_M03_DLG014.speaker: MARA
CH01_M03_DLG014.text: Put the screen back before you restart it.

CH01_M03_DLG016.speaker: MARA
CH01_M03_DLG016.text: The envelope is sealed, Officer. Read it somewhere private.

CH01_M03_DLG018.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG018.text: Remember that. Do not mistake it for kindness.

CH01_M03_DLG019.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG019.text: After count, I open my panel. You watch the landing.

CH01_M03_DLG020.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M03_DLG020.text: We leave together. No doors shut behind the other man.

CH01_M03_DLG023.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M03_DLG023.text: It is a promise. Those need practice.

CH01_M03_DLG024.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M03_DLG024.text: Hands back. Lock it down again.

CH01_M04_DLG001.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M04_DLG001.text: Final count. Faces at the bars.

CH01_M04_DLG005.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M04_DLG005.text: He turns at the clock. Wait.

CH01_M04_DLG007.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M04_DLG007.text: Now. His back is to us.

CH01_M04_DLG008.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M04_DLG008.text: Panel is loose. Do not touch the edge.

CH01_M04_DLG009.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M04_DLG009.text: That is your idea of a door?

CH01_M04_DLG011.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M04_DLG011.text: Your hatch is open. Come through.

CH01_M04_DLG015.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M04_DLG015.text: He heard the pipe. Let him pass.

CH01_M04_DLG017.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M04_DLG017.text: Far enough that we keep our voices down.

CH01_M04_DLG018.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M04_DLG018.text: We still have the same promise?

CH01_M04_DLG021.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M04_DLG021.text: Wait for his turn this time.

CH01_M05_DLG001.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG001.text: West side is a catwalk. Yours?

CH01_M05_DLG002.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG002.text: Floor route. Water below it, no way across.

CH01_M05_DLG004.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG004.text: I hear you. Better than through a wall.

CH01_M05_DLG005.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG005.text: Selector has A, B, C. Which feeds the grille?

CH01_M05_DLG006.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG006.text: Diagram said B. Brake first. Give me a second.

CH01_M05_DLG007.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG007.text: Brake held. My hands are clear of the chain.

CH01_M05_DLG009.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG009.text: Grille is up. Latch caught. You can let go.

CH01_M05_DLG013.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG013.text: Look at the dates. Transfer codes. No names. No destination.

CH01_M05_DLG014.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG014.text: A boat every Thursday. No receiving prison.

CH01_M05_DLG017.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG017.text: It is damaged. We do not know who that is.

CH01_M05_DLG018.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG018.text: Elena said that when our father was late coming home.

CH01_M05_DLG019.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG019.text: Somebody could know that. A recording could be old.

CH01_M05_DLG021.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG021.text: That is when it was copied. Keep the words. Keep moving.

CH01_M05_DLG022.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG022.text: If there is a boat, there is a way to find her.

CH01_M05_DLG023.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M05_DLG023.text: Breaker tripped. Set it back to neutral.

CH01_M05_DLG024.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M05_DLG024.text: No rush. Brake, then B, then power.

CH01_M06_DLG003.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M06_DLG003.text: Let go of the door. Slowly.

CH01_M06_DLG005.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M06_DLG005.text: I was told where to wait.

CH01_M06_DLG006.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M06_DLG006.text: You left the diagram where we could find it.

CH01_M06_DLG007.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M06_DLG007.text: I left you a route. I thought that was all they wanted.

CH01_M06_DLG012.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M06_DLG012.text: Then look at him when you say it.

CH01_M06_DLG014.speaker: GUARD
CH01_M06_DLG014.text: On your knees. Both of you.

CH01_M06_DLG016.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M06_DLG016.text: No. Look at me. We stay alive.

CH01_M06_DLG018.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M06_DLG018.text: I knew nothing was free. I did not know it was him.

CH01_M06_DLG019.speaker: RUSK
CH01_M06_DLG019.text: Separate cells. No hospital transfer. They stay here.

CH01_M06_DLG027.speaker: ADRIAN
CH01_M06_DLG027.text: Together. I am ready when you are.

CH01_M06_DLG028.speaker: NOAH
CH01_M06_DLG028.text: Three knocks. If you can hear me.
